name: OpenAI Codex CLI
summary: Tells FocusDeck when a Codex CLI session needs your approval, finishes a turn, or resumes.
description: Codex CLI lifecycle hooks report three moments: Codex is about to ask you to approve something, a turn has ended, and you have sent a new prompt. Each event carries only its kind and an opaque hash of the session id; prompts, replies, commands, paths and the working directory never leave your machine. On Codex versions without hooks, the same script works as the notify program, which reports finished turns only.

emits.when: Codex is about to ask you to approve a command, a file edit or a tool call
You send a prompt in that session

neverSends: The command, edit or tool call waiting for approval
File paths, the transcript path and the working directory

setup.title: Add the hooks to ~/.codex/config.toml
setup.body: Append this to the end of the file. If node isn't on your login shell's PATH (nvm and the like), replace node with the absolute path from `which node`. On Codex 0.124 to 0.147, delete the async lines; on older versions, see the docs for the notify alternative.

code.content:
[[hooks.PermissionRequest]]
[[hooks.PermissionRequest.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = 'node "{{FOCUSDECK_DIR}}/sensors/codex/focusdeck-hook.mjs"'
async = true
timeout = 5

[[hooks.Stop]]
[[hooks.Stop.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = 'node "{{FOCUSDECK_DIR}}/sensors/codex/focusdeck-hook.mjs"'
async = true
timeout = 5

[[hooks.UserPromptSubmit]]
[[hooks.UserPromptSubmit.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = 'node "{{FOCUSDECK_DIR}}/sensors/codex/focusdeck-hook.mjs"'
async = true
timeout = 5

setup.title: Trust the hooks
setup.body: Start codex. When it shows "Hooks need review", choose "Trust all and continue", or review each one with /hooks. Codex never runs an untrusted hook.

setup.title: Designate Codex CLI in FocusDeck
setup.body: Until Codex CLI is designated, the bridge drops its events.

test.expect: The terminal prints "focusdeck-codex: sent" with status 200, and FocusDeck shows Codex CLI finishing (session 7890f1) once Codex CLI is designated.
